comments.author: sunnystormy64
comments.body: Game engine? Pipeline? Any other info you wish to share?

replies.author: Inbellator
replies.body:
my bad, so the pipeline is GPT image for concepts, hand them off to claude opus 5.5 to model stuff in  blender(via MCP), then import to Unreal 5( via MCP). Opus 5.5 is pretty good at arranging stuff with modular asset building, but you do need to tweak manually sometimes, espiecally for level design sake. It's very do at procedual stuff, so scattering distance objects and such.

most of the work for lighting and fog is done in the post process along with material stuff as well, you can really do a lot of work in post process with the style tbh espiecally for non realistic looking games.
